text.tspan: Gap in GDP per hour worked with respect to the United States1970 to 2016
Figure illustrates the gap in GDP per hour worked with respect to the United States. The gap is calculated by
taking a country's GDP per hour worked minus that of the US, divided by US GDP per hour worked. A positive
gap suggests the country is more productive (has higher GDP per hour worked) than the US.
